name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.21: an unsupported command result now raises an alert instead of vanishing. A machine that answers unsupported is telling us the dashboard offered a control its build cannot perform, but that status was stored and shown nowhere — the operator saw a sent toast and nothing happened. This has now caused three separate silent failures (clear_aisle_fault reaching an unhandled command, read_temp, and set_temp against builds that implement set_cooling), so it raises a warning alert naming the control, the machine and its app version, deduped per command per machine per day. Also withdraws probe_addresses from the allow-list and the dashboard: it reported no modules on the bus in the same minute read_all_trays returned twenty-seven working trays, and a diagnostic that produces confident false negatives is worse than none. Cumulative over v6.20.
